crossRefs.note: “Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all…
I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.”
As for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do…
“As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you…

translations.web: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.
translations.bsb: Although He had warned Solomon explicitly not to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the LORD’s command.
translations.kjv: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
translations.asv: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which Jehovah commanded.
